# PONS

> > PONS is a comprehensive online translation and language learning platform offering text translation, dictionary services, and vocabulary training across 40+ languages.

PONS provides multilingual translation tools with integrated voice input/output, dictionary lookup, and vocabulary training features. The platform supports major European languages (Spanish, Italian, German, French, English) as well as Arabic, Persian, Greek, Latvian, and Croatian, serving both casual users and language learners.

## Key Topics

- PONS online text translator
- PONS online dictionary
- PONS vocabulary trainer app
- Multilingual translation
- Voice input/output translation
- Spanish translation
- Arabic translation
- Dictionary integration
- Language learning tools
- Text translation services
- European language pairs
- Greek and Persian translation
- Vocabulary training
- Online translator platform

## Spanish Translation Services

- [PONS Spanish ↔ Italian Translator](https://en.pons.com/text-translation-2/spanish-italian): Spanish-Italian translation tool with voice input/output and dictionary
- [PONS Spanish ↔ Latvian Translator](https://en.pons.com/text-translation/spanish-latvian): Spanish-Latvian translator with voice and vocabulary training features
- [PONS Spanish ↔ Croatian Translator](https://en.pons.com/text-translation-2/spanish-croatian): Spanish-Croatian translation with voice and dictionary integration
- [PONS Arabic ↔ Spanish Translator](https://en.pons.com/text-translation-2/arabic-spanish): Arabic-Spanish translator with voice input/output capabilities

## Middle Eastern and Mediterranean Languages

- [PONS Persian ↔ Greek Translator](https://en.pons.com/text-translation/persian-greek): Persian-Greek translation service with multilingual support
- [PONS Greek ↔ Arabic Translator](https://en.pons.com/text-translation/greek-arabic): Greek-Arabic translation app with voice and dictionary features
